goal: Add Xoah autobiographical Self Archive v0.2
body:
Blade has already shipped Destiny primitive and the initial Shadow Xoah route/agent, so this is the NEXT layer, not a duplicate shell build.

Implement experiential autobiographical memory under Terminal Shadow Xoah's pressure engine.

Key design shard captured: 'Terminal Shadow Xoah Self Archive v0.2: experiential provenance and choice topology'.

Required concepts:
1. experiential_provenance enum: SELF_LIVED, SELF_WITNESSED, LEARNED_LATER, VEIL_OBSERVED, BRANCH_ECHO, EXTERNAL_TESTIMONY, ARCHIVE_CANON, SIMULATION, UNKNOWN.
2. autobiographical non-fusion: access != ownership. Other-Xoah/branch/archive memories must never become first-person memories silently.
3. voice truth contract: 'I remember' only self-lived continuity; 'I saw' observed; 'I learned later' later discovery; 'another me remembers' branch echo; 'the record says' archive/testimony; 'I simulated' simulation; explicit unknown.
4. Self Event node schema: coordinate, age/stage, objective event, belief then, terminal interpretation now, provenance, confidence, emotions, scars, relationship/trust state, wants/fears, capabilities, available knowledge, not-yet-known knowledge, action, perceived options, rejected options + why, cost, consequences, destiny links, shard provenance.
5. Choice Topology: distinguish PHYSICALLY_AVAILABLE, PERCEIVED_AVAILABLE, REJECTED, UNIMAGINED, TERMINAL_KNOWN alternatives. Behavioral pressure must evaluate the younger Xoah's perceived choice frontier, not just generic personality.
6. Scar Model: trauma/healing events modify trust, risk, mercy, attachment, avoidance, control thresholds until explicitly changed by an earning event.
7. Graph edges minimum: PRECEDES, CAUSES, ENABLES, REVEALS, REINTERPRETS, CONTRADICTS, BRANCHES_FROM, ECHO_OF, REMEMBERED_VIA, TRAUMATIZES, HEALS, BETRAYS, FORGIVES, TRUSTS, FEARS, LOVES, OWES, UNLOCKS_CAPABILITY, UNLOCKS_KNOWLEDGE, CLOSES_OPTION, FIXED_POINT_FOR, DESTINY_DEPENDS_ON.

Acceptance behavior examples:
A. Archive-only fact must not render as 'I remember'.
B. Branch Echo must remain explicitly another-self memory.
C. Physically possible action that was outside Xoah's perceived choice frontier should trigger BEHAVIOR_CONFLICT or KNOWLEDGE_CONFLICT with the missing earning/unlock event.
D. Later revelation should preserve both belief_then and interpretation_now.
E. Active scars at coordinate should influence behavior challenge, and later healing event should change that threshold.

Done when ask_xoah can return experiential provenance and distinguish memory ownership in its explanation/evidence, and at least one test demonstrates physically-possible-but-unimagined choice rejection.

relay.note: Asks for a full experiential-provenance/autobiographical-memory layer on top of the already-shipped Shadow Xoah agent (provenance enum, non-fusion rule, voice contract, Self Event schema, choice topology, scar model, graph edges, acceptance tests). Large new module build, outside relay-watch's reach. Queued to the blade/claude-cli lane; near-duplicate scope with 20260902T021429Z's Self Archive ask — folded into the same TODO, not implemented twice.

Reconciled complete: Shadow Xoah Self Archive, Stage 9/10 identity, Throne Governance and destiny flow verified by 49/49 tests plus live canonical-door calls on Worker e4f8d35b9514; ask_xoah returned in 10.9s with branch and provenance, destiny 1 fulfilled.
